title: A hand-written record fills one slot
statement: Each technical record of STEGO that no tooling record generates and nothing provides MUST fill exactly one slot of this pattern.

title: A fill serves an essential record
statement: Each fill MUST implement, build or sit under an essential record; code that serves no essential record MUST be removed.

title: A fill follows the code standard
statement: Each fill MUST meet every rule of ST-STD-CODE that applies to its kind.

title: The domain's tests run on a workstation
statement: Each automated test of an obligation of the domain MUST run on a developer's workstation with only local, unprivileged services, as ST-STD-LOCAL-R01 says. It MUST NOT need a shared cluster or a hosted service.
notes: This serves ST-BO07, Evidence for every claim: a reviewer or an agent can repeat a run at an exact commit only when it needs no shared system. This serves ST-BO02, Consumers feed the registry: a consumer team proves a component without access to the platform's cluster or CI.

title: One documented command runs each suite of the domain
statement: Each suite that holds tests of the domain MUST run from one documented command, as ST-STD-LOCAL-R02 says.
notes: This serves ST-BO02, Consumers feed the registry: a consumer team proves a component without access to the platform's cluster or CI. A builder or an agent finds the command without the help of the platform team. This serves ST-BO07, Evidence for every claim: a reviewer or an agent can repeat a run at an exact commit only when it needs no shared system.

title: Each outside system of the domain has a local stand-in
statement: Each test of the domain that needs an outside system MUST run against a local stand-in that keeps the system's contract, as ST-STD-LOCAL-R03 says. A test against the real system MAY exist in addition, never in place of it.
notes: This serves ST-BO07, Evidence for every claim: a reviewer or an agent can repeat a run at an exact commit only when it needs no shared system. The real system can change or be down, so a proof against it alone cannot be repeated. This serves ST-BO02, Consumers feed the registry: a consumer team proves a component without access to the platform's cluster or CI.

title: The domain's local services start at pinned versions
statement: Each local service that a test of the domain needs MUST be started by the test or its suite, at a pinned version, as ST-STD-LOCAL-R04 says.
notes: This serves ST-BO07, Evidence for every claim: a reviewer or an agent can repeat a run at an exact commit only when it needs no shared system. A service at a moving version gives another run at the same commit.

title: The domain's tests leave no state outside a temporary folder
statement: Each test of the domain and each local service that it starts MUST leave no state outside a temporary folder when the test ends, as ST-STD-LOCAL-R05 says.
notes: This serves ST-BO07, Evidence for every claim: a reviewer or an agent can repeat a run at an exact commit only when it needs no shared system. State that a run leaves behind can change the result of the next run at the same commit.

title: A cluster test of the domain is never the only proof
statement: A performance, stress or scale test of the domain MAY need a shared cluster, but MUST NOT be the only proof of an obligation of the domain, as ST-STD-LOCAL-R06 says.
notes: This serves ST-BO07, Evidence for every claim: a reviewer or an agent can repeat a run at an exact commit only when it needs no shared system. AGENTS.md keeps performance and stress tests off the workstation, so a test of that kind needs a cluster, and the obligation also needs a proof that runs locally.
